explication: Free Claude Code is a local compatibility proxy and coding-agent hub. A coding client sends Anthropic- or OpenAI-compatible requests to the API; handlers acquire a runtime lease, resolve the configured model and fallbacks, invoke a provider, and stream the translated result back. Separate browser code sessions persist runs and drive harnesses. Messaging clients enter a workflow backed by conversation trees and managed Claude sessions. The Admin UI configures providers, integrations, and sessions. The tree supports provider routing, native sessions, messaging, tools, and optional voice integrations; several subsystem links remain inferred from documented interfaces rather than sampled implementations.
